name: CVE-2026-PHP-SESSION-CHAIN
description: CVE-2026-115560 + CVE-2026-126714 (phpAfterShell) — analysis, lab reproduction with a real Guzzle gadget chain, and honest live-phase findings. No target data.
vuln_description:
Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: CVE-2026-35376
description: uutils chcon <0.10.0: recursive relabel re-resolves fts_accpath by path — rename/symlink race redirects privileged SELinux relabel. openat(dirfd) fix from 7cfc74e: swapped path hits /etc/passwd on vuln, original inode on fixed
vuln_description: A Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerability exists in the chcon utility of uutils coreutils during recursive operations. The implementation resolves recursive targets using a fresh path lookup (via fts_accpath) rather than binding the traversal and label application to the specific directory state encountered during traversal. Because these operations are not anchored to file descriptors, a local attacker with write access to a directory tree can exploit timing-sensitive rename or symbolic link races to redirect a privileged recursive relabeling operation to unintended files or directories. This vulnerability breaks the hardening expectations for SELinux administration workflows and can lead to the unauthorized modification of security labels on sensitive system objects.

name: CVE-2026-77331
description: memtomem <761db18: concurrent RPC failures start duplicate reconnects for one dirty surfacing session, cancellation can reuse replacement session. Guard model from 761db18: 2 reconnects on vuln, 1 on fixed
vuln_description: memtomem-stm is a short-term memory proxy gateway with proactive memory surfacing for AI agents. Cancellation during a post-reconnect retry can also leave the replacement transport reusable after an interrupted protocol exchange, causing session-state integrity loss or local service degradation. The duplicate-reconnect subcase was introduced in 0.1.24, while the cancellation-recovery subcase affects the broader listed range. This issue is fixed in version 0.1.34.

name: CVE-2026-58262
description: Klever-go: bitmap padding bits counted toward block-signing quorum while BLS ignores them — block accepted without real 2/3 validator quorum. Verbatim verifier from a11cb28^ vs fix: 6-sig block with padding bit passes on vuln, rejected on fixed
vuln_description: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Prior to 1.7.20, header signature verification counts the unused padding bits of the PubKeysBitmap toward the two-thirds validator quorum. These padding bits do not correspond to any validator and are ignored by the actual BLS aggregate-signature check, so a malicious or compromised block producer can set them to reach the required quorum while gathering fewer genuine validator signatures than the protocol demands. As a result, nodes that import or intercept the header accept it as correctly signed without a real two-thirds quorum, weakening consensus safety and undermining finality. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.20.

name: CVE-2026-63476

Node.js heap limits do not mitigate the off-heap Buffer allocation. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.6.

name: CVE-2026-94567
description: NukeViet CMS SVG Upload XSS Filter Bypass — CVSS 9.3
vuln_description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.12 and 4.6.02, an attacker with access to an SVG upload flow can hide a script element in an internal DTD entity. NukeViet\Files\Upload::check_svg_tmpfile() loads the document without entity expansion, leaving a DOMEntityReference, and sanitize_svg_dom() inspects only element nodes, while browsers expand the entity when the stored file is served as image/svg+xml. The SVG path also returned before verify_image() and preserved the original bytes, so the hidden script reached disk unchanged. Guest comment attachments make the upload unauthenticated only when a module's comment feature is open to the All or Guest group and allowattachcomm is enabled; module administrators can also use the file manager, allowing same-origin script execution in an administrator's session. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.12 and 4.6.02.

name: CVE-2026-94565

vuln_description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. NukeViet\Core\Request::filterTags() tokenizes attributes using only ASCII spaces, so it sees /onerror and misses the ^on denylist, while the browser treats the slash as a separator and activates onerror. The message is stored and rendered without output encoding in the administration panel, which lacks a Content Security Policy, allowing same-origin JavaScript execution when an administrator opens the message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

name: CVE-2026-132660
description: EDB Postgres Enterprise Manager Cross-Agent Job Manipulation IDOR — CVSS 9.4
vuln_description:
In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), several SECURITY DEFINER functions in the pem schema of the PEM backend database are owned by a superuser but do not set a safe search_path. Any PEM user who can connect to the PEM backend database can create objects that these functions use in place of the intended ones, and so run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges. Temporary objects can be used for this on every supported PostgreSQL version, and objects in the public schema on PostgreSQL 14 backends and backends upgraded from PostgreSQL 14.
From PEM 10.6.1, these functions run with a fixed search_path.

name: CVE-2026-132659
description: EDB Postgres Enterprise Manager Untrusted Search Path DLL Hijacking — CVSS 9.4
vuln_description:
In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the row-level security policies on pem.job and pem.jobstep that apply to PEM agents do not limit an agent to its own jobs. An attacker who controls one monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can create, change or delete jobs for every other agent, including the agent on the PEM server. Agents run SQL job steps with the database credentials of the server they monitor, and shell job steps where batch jobs are enabled, so compromising one monitored host can give superuser SQL access to every monitored database and to the PEM backend.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents can no longer create jobs or change job definitions or job steps.

name: CVE-2026-132658
description: EDB Postgres Enterprise Manager Improper Privilege Management — CVSS 9.4
vuln_description:
In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role, which every PEM agent login inherits, is a member of the PostgreSQL pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files roles on the PEM backend database. An attacker who controls any monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can read and write files on the PEM server host as the postgres operating system user. This includes the PEM certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certificates for other agents and act as them.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents no longer hold these roles.

freed while the SYNACK is still being built. TCP child sockets do

name: CVE-2026-128138
description: NLTK Java Launcher OS Command Injection via Token — CVSS 9.8

From 3.10.3 until 3.10.4, the NLTK 3.10.3 JVM hardening validates Java launcher tokens in the options channel but appends the caller-controlled cmd sequence without requiring its first token to be a main class. vuln_description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to SQL injection in the edge-controller component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access or modify sensitive database information.

name: CVE-2026-14492
description: WP Duplicate WordPress Plugin Authentication Bypass and Path Traversal — CVSS 9.8
vuln_description: The WP Duplicate – WordPress Migration Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.11 via the save_single_batch_file function. This is due to a PHP type-juggling authentication bypass via loose != comparison with no is_string() guard, combined with unsanitized base64-decoded path construction in save_single_batch_file() lacking any directory traversal containment. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to execute code on the server. Exploitation requires that the site owner has completed the plugin's initial setup so that the site_type and prod_key_random_id options are non-empty, though any non-empty secret value is bypassable via the type-juggling flaw.

name: CVE-2026-132079
description: Apache Iggy Go SDK Session Token Non-Expiration — CVSS 9.8
vuln_description:
Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for.

This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their long expiry on the server. Delete those tokens and create new ones.

name: CVE-2026-110513
description: Apache Iggy Predictable User ID Reuse After Deletion — CVSS 9.8
vuln_description:
Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID. After an administrator deleted a user, that user's unexpired token, or a token refreshed from it while the ID was free, authenticated as the next account created with that ID and had that account's permissions. Only deployments with HTTP enabled are affected.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: through 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

name: CVE-2026-128981

name: CVE-2026-129496
description: PHP DateTimeZone Cache Use-After-Free
vuln_description:
Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution.

In non-thread-safe builds, a diagnostic written to a file-based error_log during module startup, for example for an invalid date.timezone value or a session configuration warning, causes the timezone cache to be allocated in startup memory that is freed while a reference to it is kept. A diagnostic raised early in the first request of a worker, such as the max_input_vars warning, then accesses the freed cache. On such a deployment an unauthenticated remote attacker can crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers with a crafted request. Arbitrary code execution may be possible and has been demonstrated with known memory addresses.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: CVE-2026-129474
description: PHP Magic Method Backtrace Use-After-Free RCE
vuln_description:
Use-after-free in magic method backtraces can lead to remote code execution.

When collecting the arguments of a method call handled by __call() or __callStatic() for a backtrace, PHP can read stale values that may refer to freed memory. If a fatal error such as exceeding memory_limit occurs while an application enters such a call, with fatal_error_backtraces enabled (the default) and zend.exception_ignore_args disabled, a remote attacker who controls enough request data to influence memory allocation may cause memory corruption, crash the PHP worker or, with knowledge of memory addresses, execute arbitrary code. php.ini-production enables zend.exception_ignore_args, which prevents this.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: CVE-2026-129289
description: PHP-FPM FastCGI Record Smuggling RCE
vuln_description:
PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body.

PHP does not discard the unread part of an HTTP request body at request shutdown when the application has opened php://input without reading it to the end. When the front end reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache (for example nginx with fastcgi_keep_conn on, or Apache mod_proxy_fcgi with enablereuse=on), PHP-FPM can parse the leftover bytes as a new FastCGI request. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use a single crafted multipart/form-data request to forge a backend request with chosen parameters such as SCRIPT_FILENAME, REMOTE_ADDR and PHP_ADMIN_VALUE, which can lead to execution of attacker-controlled PHP code. With LSAPI, subsequent requests on the connection can be disrupted.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: CVE-2026-128134
description: NLTK — dot2img runs Graphviz outside trusted-exec check, enabling local code execution via PATH hijacking. High.

description: CVE-2026-126978 / CVE-2026-126979 — Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit HAP pre-auth heap overflow and ChaCha20 integer underflow. TLV8 fuzzer with crash probe.

name: CVE-2026-120539

This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.

Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.

name: CVE-2026-119258
description: CVE-2026-119258 — Unauthenticated authentication bypass in the Swipe WordPress plugin (<= 1.4). Issues a valid WordPress session cookie for any user with an active app session, admins included. Working PoC + write-up.
vuln_description: The Swipe WordPress plugin through 1.4 does not properly authenticate a login request before issuing a WordPress session cookie, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, when that user has an active app session.

name: CVE-2026-118899
description: CVE-2026-118899 — nginx worker infinite loop (CWE-835) in TLS 1.3 request-body path. CPU exhaustion DoS on nginx 1.13.0–1.31.8. Docker PoC.
vuln_description:
When using the listen directive with the ssl parameter in the http block with TLSv1.3 enabled, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS connection to cause an infinite loop in the NGINX worker process while reading the HTTP request body. As a result, the worker process stops accepting new connections and processing existing connections. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Impact: This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of NGINX. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

name: CVE-2026-118028

vuln_description:
Execution After Redirect (EAR) vulnerability in Apache Tomcat in RedirectValve affecting flags [F], [G] and [R].

name: CVE-2026-116448
description: Dell PowerStore SDNAS — Unauthenticated OS command injection via REST API yields root RCE. CVSS 3.1: 9.8 Critical.
vuln_description: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.

name: CVE-2026-116442
description: Dell PowerStore SDNAS — NDMP authentication replay bypass gives full backup/restore control. CVSS 3.1: 8.1 High.
vuln_description: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an authentication-bypass-by-replay vulnerability in the NAS NDMP service that could allow a network attacker to gain backup and restore control of the appliance.

name: CVE-2026-115560
description: CVE-2026-115560 -- PHP Session Upload Progress Serialize-Handler Mismatch -> Unauthenticated Object Injection / RCE. CVSS 9.8 Critical.
vuln_description:
Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: CVE-2026-114938
description: CVE-2026-114938 — Java HotSpot x86-64 Base64 AVX-512 intrinsic heap overflow (Java4Shell). Detect, crash and remote PoC with Docker harness.
vuln_description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u511b33-perf, 17.0.21.0.3, 21.0.13.0.3, 25.0.5.0.3, 27.0.1.0.3; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.3 and  21.0.13.0.3; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.3. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a web service. name: CVE-2026-114516
description: Etherpad Pre-Auth Arbitrary File Read
vuln_description: Etherpad is a real-time collaborative editor. From 1.8.14 until 3.3.3, the pre-authentication /static/* plugin asset handler in src/node/utils/Minify.ts performs a backslash-to-forward-slash conversion after src/node/utils/sanitizePathname.ts has completed its POSIX path checks. On POSIX systems the sanitizer correctly treats backslashes as ordinary filename bytes, but the later conversion turns encoded backslash-separated parent-directory segments into traversal components without revalidation or containment. The expressPreSession registration and the always-present ep_etherpad-lite core pseudo-plugin make this path reachable without credentials, allowing a remote attacker to read any file available to the Etherpad process. Disclosed configuration or environment secrets can expose administrator credentials, after which the administrator plugin installer can provide in-process code execution and full server compromise. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.3.

name: CVE-2026-114202
description: CVE-2026-114202 — ASUS Control Center Express hard-coded JWT key to forged admin token (CVSS 10.0). Three-stage PoC: fingerprint, discover, forge.
vuln_description:
Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

name: CVE-2026-113425
description: CVE-2026-113425 — nginx mail proxy use-after-free triggered by TCP RST during IMAP auth. Affects nginx 0.5.33–1.31.8. Docker PoC lab.
vuln_description:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a mail proxy, undisclosed traffic can cause a use-after-free in an nginx worker process. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
A remote unauthenticated attacker may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service. Remote code execution is a potential impact. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

name: CVE-2026-111497
description: Node.js Brotli decoder OOB write (node2shell) + related Node.js Oct 2026 vulns
vuln_description:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

name: CVE-2026-110960
description: CVE-2026-110960 — Unauthenticated account takeover in the Auth Armor WordPress plugin (<= 1.0.3). Leaks stored API credentials, resets admin enrollment, mints a valid admin session. Full chain PoC.
vuln_description: The Auth Armor  WordPress plugin through 1.0.3 does not require authentication on several handlers available to logged-out users, which leak the site's stored API credentials and allow an unauthenticated attacker to reset an administrator's enrollment and take over that administrator account.

name: CVE-2026-109618
description: PHP2Shell OOM use-after-free memory leak via session.upload_progress (CVE-2026-109618 + -109619)
vuln_description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

name: CVE-2026-104099
description: Fabio Access-Control Bypass via Unnormalized Request Paths
vuln_description: Fabio is an HTTP(S) and TCP router for deploying applications managed by consul. Prior to 1.7.3, route/table.go selects targets using raw req.URL.Path, while proxy/http_proxy.go applies per-route ACL and basic-auth checks to the selected target and forwards the raw path to the origin. Dot-segment, encoded-dot, or repeated-slash variants can fall through to a less restrictive route that reaches the same backend; the backend then normalizes the path and serves the protected resource without the configured access controls. A less restrictive fallback route must reach the same backend; without one, the request returns 404. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.3.

name: CVE-2026-100397
description: CVE-2026-100397 — Rucio SSH challenge token auth bypass (CVSS 10.0). Unauthenticated account impersonation via forged SSH challenge tokens.
vuln_description: Rucio is a scientific data management framework. From 1.14.0 until 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1, validate_auth_token in lib/rucio/core/authentication.py does not distinguish short-lived SSH challenge nonces from authentication tokens stored in the same token table. An unauthenticated attacker can request /auth/ssh_challenge_token for an arbitrary account by supplying X-Rucio-Account, then present the returned X-Rucio-SSH-Challenge-Token as X-Rucio-Auth-Token to authenticate to other API endpoints as that account, including an administrative account. This issue is fixed in versions 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1.

name: CVE-2025-31133
description: runc container escape via procfs TOCTOU race (CVE-2025-31133 + -52565 + -52881, runc < 1.3.0)
vuln_description: runc is a CLI tool for spawning and running containers according to the OCI specification. In versions 1.2.7 and below, 1.3.0-rc.1 through 1.3.1, 1.4.0-rc.1 and 1.4.0-rc.2 files, runc would not perform sufficient verification that the source of the bind-mount (i.e., the container's /dev/null) was actually a real /dev/null inode when using the container's /dev/null to mask. This exposes two methods of attack:  an arbitrary mount gadget, leading to host information disclosure, host denial of service, container escape, or a bypassing of maskedPaths. This issue is fixed in versions 1.2.8, 1.3.3 and 1.4.0-rc.3.

name: CVE-2015-3306
description: phpFileManager 0.9.8 unauthenticated RCE via action=cd OS command injection
vuln_description: The mod_copy module in ProFTPD 1.3.5 allows remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

name: CVE-2026-123633-PoC-Toolkit
description: CVE-2026-123633 (CVSS 9.2) NGINX HTTP/2 UAF Red/Blue team toolkit. Flood & RST_STREAM race, mass scanning, crash-oracle libc brute-force, ret2libc post-exploit, HTTP/2 ALPN & h2c checks, safe PoC probe, JSON/CSV reporting, zero dependencies, Python. Built for authorized security testing. Only Ethical Uses.
vuln_description:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker_connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.




Impact:



This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or may allow a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

name: CVE-2026-22865
description: Gradle <8.14.4/9.3.0: UnknownHostException not a critical repo failure — resolution falls through to the next repository and can fetch malicious artifacts. Verbatim isCriticalFailure from d38bfc0^ vs fix: malicious artifact on vuln, repo disabled on fixed
vuln_description: Gradle is a build automation tool, and its native-platform tool provides Java bindings for native APIs. When resolving dependencies in versions before 9.3.0, some exceptions were not treated as fatal errors and would not cause a repository to be disabled. If a build encountered one of these exceptions, Gradle would continue to the next repository in the list and potentially resolve dependencies from a different repository. An exception like NoHttpResponseException can indicate transient errors. If the errors persist after a maximum number of retries, Gradle would continue to the next repository. This behavior could allow an attacker to disrupt the service of a repository and leverage another repository to serve malicious artifacts. This attack requires the attacker to have control over a repository after the disrupted repository. Gradle has introduced a change in behavior in Gradle 9.3.0 to stop searching other repositories when encountering these errors.

name: cve-2026-134814-binary-parser-option-injection
description: CVE-2026-134814 - binary-parser - Critical 9.2 - Code injection. String options are interpolated into generated parser source, so a hostile parser definition executes JavaScript. Differential lab: 2.3.0 injects via three sinks, 2.3.1 rejects all.

name: CVE-2026-129223
description: NLTK: acyclic WordNet traversal defaults to unlimited depth — long acyclic chain crashes Synset.tree() with RecursionError. Verbatim depth cap from 0e474a7d: crash on vuln, capped traversal on fixed
vuln_description: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, WordNet Synset.tree and acyclic_tree traverse relation graphs through recursive utility helpers without a depth bound. Exploitation requires the host application to load an attacker-influenced custom or foreign WordNet-format lexical resource; no relation in NLTK's bundled WordNet 3.0 corpus reaches the crash threshold. An excessively deep relation graph in such a resource can exceed the Python recursion limit and terminate the traversal or request worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

name: cve-2026-131914-poc
description: CVE-2026-131914 PoC: unauthenticated RCE in ASP.NET sites using Idunno.AntiCsrf (unkeyed ObjectStateFormatter deserialization). Single-file pure Python with DNS callback mode. Lab-tested.
vuln_description: Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection

name: CVE-2026-129222
description: NLTK: DependencyGraph tree()/triples() recurse once per edge with no depth limit — long CoNLL chain crashes with RecursionError. Verbatim traversal from a746827^ vs MAX_DEPTH=200 fix: crash on vuln, ValueError on fixed
vuln_description: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, DependencyGraph.tree and DependencyGraph.triples walk parsed dependency edges through unbounded Python recursion and do not use a working cycle or depth guard. A crafted CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency file containing a sufficiently long chain can raise RecursionError when the documented traversal APIs are called, aborting the current worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

name: CVE-2026-133469
description: Xen Orchestra: cookie authenticationToken=j:{} decodes to an object that passes the token-ID truthiness check and triggers an unfiltered lookup — auth bypass as admin. Verbatim guard from 50166fe^ vs fix: admin auth on vuln, no lookup on fixed

name: CVE-2026-111760
description: Git <2.56.1: size_t path length truncated into 32-bit ce_namelen — path validated as '.gitz/...' written as '.git' during checkout (RCE in recursive clone). Verbatim verify_ce_namelen from 29411cf: .git overwrite on vuln, rejection on fixed
vuln_description: Git is a fast, scalable, distributed revision control system with an unusually rich command set that provides both high-level operations and full access to internals. Prior to 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1, an attacker-controlled repository hosted by the attacker rather than on a normal forge site can exploit git clone --recurse-submodules by causing Git to overwrite a submodule gitfile with a symbolic link. The symbolic link can point to a directory containing attacker-controlled Git configuration or hooks, allowing those hooks or configuration to execute code on the cloning user's system. The issue requires the recursive-submodule option, and users should avoid cloning repositories from untrusted sources. This issue is fixed in versions 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1.

name: CVE-2026-114466
description: Git <2.56.1: fast-import stream directives rewrite-submodules-from/to and export-pack-edges read/write arbitrary files — unsafe-feature list not updated. Verbatim guards from 2b50a97+19bcf62: file access on vuln, refusal on fixed
vuln_description: Arbitrary data can be read or written through git-fast-import(1) and git-fast-export(1) features not marked unsafe

name: CVE-2026-113408
description: Git <2.56.1: protocol v2 copies advertised unborn HEAD symref-target into .git/HEAD without validation — traversal write outside refs/. Verbatim acceptance from b371db8^ vs fix: traversal target stored on vuln, warning + fallback on fixed
vuln_description: Path traversal in Git allows writing to arbitrary file via cloning and committing to bad repository

name: CVE-2026-114469
description: Git <2.56.1: binary patch size check uses input size only — a compressed patch inflates past the cap and reads out of bounds in patch_delta(). Verbatim decoded-length guard from 55c54fd^ vs fix with ASan: heap OOB read on vuln, rejection on fixed
vuln_description: Out-of-bounds read can crash git-apply(1) when binary patch inflates to very large size

name: CVE-2026-114467
description: Git <2.56.1: remove_signature() tracks at most two GPG signatures in a fixed-size stack array — a third signature writes past it. Verbatim C function from aff58722^ vs fix with ASan: stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8 on vuln, clean on fixed
vuln_description: Out-of-bounds write possible in Git when git-merge(1) used on tag with more than two GPG signatures

name: CVE-2026-95517
description: Security Bypass via Obfuscation Without Integrity Checking
vuln_description:
Reliance on obfuscation or encryption of Security-Relevant inputs without integrity checking, Improper validation of integrity check value, Cleartext transmission of sensitive information vulnerability in the EncryptInterceptor of Apache Tomcat.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.27, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.61, from 9.0.13 through 9.0.123.



The following versions were EOL at the time the CVE was created but are known to be affected: from 8.5.38 through 8.5.100, from 7.0.100 through 7.0.109. Other unsupported versions may also be affected.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.29, 10.1.62 or 9.0.124 and switch to TLS-PSK to encrypt cluster communication, which fixes the issue.
Note: Tomcat 11.0.28 was not released

name: CVE-2026-92182
description: CVE-2026-92182 — pfSense CE XMLRPC incorrect authorization to root RCE. Low-privileged account reaches admin-only methods; method reachability probe plus admin comparison.
vuln_description:
Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

name: CVE-2026-80188
description: BuddyBoss Addons WordPress Authentication Bypass
vuln_description: The BuddyBoss Addons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in versions up to, and including, 1.2.1. This is due to the Social Login REST endpoint trusting unverified Apple and Facebook identity-token claims and linking an attacker-controlled provider identifier to an existing WordPress user selected by the token’s email claim. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who know a user’s email address to associate their provider identity with that account, including administrator accounts, and subsequently authenticate as the victim. Successful exploitation requires the BuddyBoss Platform plugin to be installed and active, with the Social Login module and selected provider enabled and configured. On sites with the separate BuddyBoss App JWT component, the vulnerable REST request can return an application token immediately.

name: CVE-2026-77369
description: Daptin Broken Access Control IDOR in YJS Collaboration
vuln_description: Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. From 0.11.4 until 0.12.30, the generic GET /yjs/:documentName WebSocket route in InitializeYjsResources requires a session but does not authorize the database resource selected by a typename.referenceId.columnName room name. The YJS initial-content provider then reads the selected file.* column without CanRead or CanUpdate checks, and bidirectional synchronization allows a low-privileged authenticated user to read or modify restricted row content. Unauthenticated requests are rejected, and standalone non-canonical room names remain shared-by-name rooms. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.30.

name: CVE-2026-77367
description: Daptin Unauthenticated SQL Injection via sort Parameter
vuln_description: Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. Prior to 0.12.30, the generic GET /api/{entity} list endpoint accepts attacker-controlled sort values in PaginatedFindAllWithoutFilters in server/resource/resource_findallpaginated.go without validating the requested column against the table schema. The code uses those values for SELECT and ORDER BY identifier construction, so an embedded identifier quote can terminate the quoted identifier and make the remainder parse as SQL, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to extract unauthorized table data through blind or error-based behavior or repeatedly trigger query failures. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.30.

name: CVE-2026-77312
description: Flyto2 Core Arbitrary File Write via Unguarded Modules
vuln_description: Flyto2 Core is an execution kernel for automation and AI-agent workflows. Prior to 2.26.8, the earlier CVE-2026-67429 remediation applied validate_path_with_env_config() to only a hand-picked set of file-writing modules, leaving data.csv.write in src/core/modules/atomic/data/csv_write.py, data.json_to_csv in src/core/modules/atomic/data/json_to_csv.py, file.copy in src/core/modules/atomic/file/copy.py, and file.move in src/core/modules/atomic/file/move.py outside the FLYTO_SANDBOX_DIR confinement boundary. The advisory also identifies unguarded modules across the broader data.*, file.*, and report-writer families. data.csv.write relies on a .. substring denylist that does not reject absolute paths, while the other named modules accept caller-controlled output or destination paths without the canonical guard. A caller able to execute modules or recipes can therefore write attacker-controlled content outside the configured sandbox, potentially overwriting application code, recipes, startup files, scheduled-task

name: CVE-2026-75521
description: Miren Runtime (Go) — Unverified TLS client certs in RPC layer grant cluster superuser access. Critical.
vuln_description: Miren Runtime provides the runtime component for the Miren application platform. Prior to 0.11.1, the QUIC/HTTP3 RPC server on the default port 8443 uses tls.RequestClientCert and does not verify that presented certificates chain to the configured cluster certificate authority. The RPC authenticators derive a caller identity from PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName without requiring a non-empty VerifiedChains value, and certificate identities bypass all RBAC checks. A network attacker who can reach the listener can present a self-signed certificate with an issuer distinguished name matching the public cluster CA subject and gain cluster superuser access, allowing disclosure, modification, or disruption of applications, sandboxes, disks, credentials, and other managed resources. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.1.

name: CVE-2026-71481
description: altcha CAPTCHA HMAC signature bypass allows bot automation without valid signature. High.
vuln_description: ALTCHA PHP is a lightweight PHP library for creating and verifying ALTCHA challenges. From 2.0.0 until 2.0.3, the verifySolution method skips HMAC signature verification when a challenge payload omits the signature field, even when hmacSignatureSecret is configured. An attacker can remove the signature, supply attacker-selected low-difficulty challenge parameters, solve the resulting proof of work, and submit a payload that verifies successfully, bypassing the CAPTCHA control. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.

name: CVE-2026-69158
description: atomic-server — Unauthenticated full-response SSRF via /bookmark endpoint. High.
vuln_description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. Prior to 0.40.3, unauthenticated requests to /bookmark can supply a url that server/src/plugins/bookmark.rs passes through fetch_data to fetch_body. Endpoint dispatch in lib/src/db.rs invokes the handler before check_read, and lib/src/client/helpers.rs previously checked only that the URL began with HTTP, without restricting loopback, private, link-local, DNS-rebinding, or redirect targets. The handler reflects fetched content in returned resource fields, making this a full-response server-side request forgery that can expose internal services and plain-GET cloud metadata. The short request timeout limits slow targets, and metadata services requiring a separate token request are outside the demonstrated GET-only path. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

name: CVE-2026-69157
description: atomic-server — Unauthenticated /setup invite grants full Drive write access. Critical.
vuln_description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.29.0 to 0.40.2, Atomic Server provisions a well-known /setup invite with write enabled, the Drive root as its target, and usagesLeft set to one. construct_invite_redirect in server/src/plugins/invite.rs discards the redeemer identity, so an unauthenticated request containing an attacker-controlled public-key can create a new Agent and grant it write access to the entire Drive. On a fresh, unclaimed deployment, this permits reading, modifying, or deleting resources, changing permissions, and creating or altering Agents. No complete fixed version was verified as of this review.

name: CVE-2026-69156
description: atomic-server — Unauthenticated arbitrary file read via /download internalId, leaking private key. High.
vuln_description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.30.0 until 0.40.3, the Commit application path in lib/src/commit.rs allows an authenticated Agent to assign the server-managed internalId property to an owned resource without character validation. The /download handler in server/src/handlers/download.rs passes that value to filesystem path construction and NamedFile::open without sanitization, containment validation, or a File-class check, so traversal or absolute paths can read files available to the server process. Reading the server configuration can expose the root Agent private key and allow root impersonation with full read, write, and delete access to server data. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

name: CVE-2026-65094
description: NVIDIA VIRTIO-Net BlueField Guest-Triggered Vulnerability

name: CVE-2026-63129
description: @connorbritain/mssql-mcp-core (npm) — SQL injection via unparameterized table names and WHERE clauses in write tools. High.
vuln_description: mssql-mcp-core is the shared library that powers MSSQL MCP servers. Prior to core and server 0.6.0 and reader and writer 0.5.0, multiple database tools interpolate caller-controlled identifiers and predicates into T-SQL batches passed to Request.query() while parameterizing only data values. update_data, delete_data, insert_data, execute_transaction, create_table, create_index, and drop_table accept unsafe tableName, column, index, schema, or free-form whereClause input, while reader-tier list_databases interpolates stateFilter without runtime allowlist enforcement. Row-count and preview queries execute before confirmUpdate or confirmDelete, allowing malicious arguments to bypass confirmation and maxRows controls and execute stacked DDL or DML, read or destroy data, and potentially run operating-system commands when the SQL login is privileged and xp_cmdshell is enabled. This issue is fixed in core and server version 0.6.0 and reader and writer version 0.5.0.
